$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-23-batch-r/2026-10-23-batch-r.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

source.operator_quote: this is a great idea! approved B′ (new, recommended) │ The same alert query, with the same one-per-window rule, moves to the tracked-projects step (update_tracked_projects). That step already runs after the forecast step and already declares every column the query touches. │ Same people. Fresher: alerts come one run earlier, and no alerts from out-of-date or deleted forecasts. │ Loop gone: 3 permits steps first, about 9–12 sessions and 5–7 nights

decisions.question: START_DATE_URGENT moves, query unchanged, to update_tracked_projects (option B′; supersedes CHAT-96.CLP-Q2 option A)
decisions.recommendation: START_DATE_URGENT is queued by update_tracked_projects (permits position 27, after compute_trade_forecasts at 25), with classify_lifecycle_phase's saved-lead query unchanged (lead_views.saved joined to trade_forecasts with predicted_start 6-7 days out; scripts/classify-lifecycle-phase.js:214-228, called at :1641-1646), at most once per (user, lead) within notifications_max_stale_hours on the run clock (option A's NOT EXISTS; seeded migrations/222_notification_gateflip.sql:54, read scripts/dispatch-notifications.js:71). classify_lifecycle_phase no longer reads trade_forecasts (CLP-D5). update_tracked_projects already reads every column the query touches and writes notifications, so no lineage is added. Same recipients; fresher forecasts (alerts one run earlier, none from out-of-date or deleted forecasts); coa-chain runs no longer queue this alert (risk: a missed window if permits runs are more than 24 h apart; measure the cadence on night N-A first). It removes the classify_lifecycle_phase <- compute_trade_forecasts edge, so the permits work needed before the CoA swaps is permits (+ the close_stale_permits fold), classify_permit_phase and link_coa.
